description.value: Firehouse Subs is a Canadian franchise of the American fast-casual sandwich chain, specializing in hot subs with a first-responder-themed brand identity. This Tsawwassen location sits at 4949 Canoe Pass Way in the Tsawwassen Mills retail area and offers dine-in, delivery, and mobile ordering. Touring cyclists in the area will find a familiar, quick-service meal stop with indoor seating and a broad sub menu.

address.value: 4949 Canoe Pass Way, Delta, BC V4M 0B2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the store is active at 4949 Canoe Pass Way, Delta, BC V4M 0B2, with dine-in, delivery, mobile ordering, and catering listed as ordering modes. No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenity information appears anywhere in the website content.
